newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London quiet with Tokyo closed.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London quiet with Tokyo closed.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London endured an extremely quiet session on Tuesday with Tokyo closed earlier for a holiday, dealers said.
At 1410 GMT the Nikkei 50, at 1513.30, was 0.48 point (0.03 percent) up from its opening level.
Tokyo markets will reopen on Wednesday.
In light pre-holiday trading in Tokyo on Monday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 index closed 57.51 points, or 0.31 percent, higher at 18,670.37 on volume of just 257 million shares.
